product_overview: HireAi is a web-based applicant tracking and candidate portal that streamlines hiring through resume ingestion, candidate evaluation, quizzes, and dashboards for HR and candidates. It provides candidates with a job board and application flow and provides HR with job and candidate management plus analytics.
core_goals: Allow candidates to browse jobs, store resumes, apply, take assessments, and view feedback.
Enable HR users to create and manage job postings, ingest and evaluate candidates, and view hiring analytics.
Provide an integrated quiz engine for technical assessments and mock tests with result reporting.
Securely authenticate users and enforce role-based access for Candidate and HR workflows.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Account creation and sign-in for Candidates and HR users, with role-aware routing to respective portals.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Choose account type (Candidate or HR) -> Fill in required registration information -> Submit signup form -> See confirmation and be directed to /login
Navigate to /signup -> Fill in registration with missing or invalid fields -> Submit signup form -> See validation errors and remain on /signup
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See /candidate/dashboard for candidates or /hr/dashboard for HR
Navigate to /login -> Fill in incorrect credentials -> Submit login form -> See authentication failure message and remain on /login

features.name: Candidate Portal (Dashboard, Job Board, Apply)
features.description: Candidate-facing portal to view a personal dashboard, browse and search jobs, store resumes, and submit applications.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/dashboard -> See overview of application statuses, saved resumes, and recommended jobs

Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Browse or search job listings -> Select a job to apply -> Start application -> Choose a stored resume or upload a new resume -> Submit application -> See application confirmation and status entry in dashboard
Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Select a job to apply -> Start application -> Attempt to submit without selecting or uploading a resume -> See validation error and remain in application flow
Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Save a job to favorites -> See job present in saved jobs on /candidate/dashboard

features.name: Quiz Engine & Mock Tests
features.description: Take timed quizzes and mock tests for technical screening with automated submission and results reporting.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/mock-test -> Start mock test -> Answer questions within allotted time -> Submit test -> See results and score breakdown

Navigate to /candidate/mock-test -> Start mock test -> Switch away from test repeatedly or exceed allowed tab-switch threshold -> Observe warning or automatic submission -> See test recorded as auto-submitted with corresponding status

Navigate to /candidate/mock-test -> Start mock test -> Lose network connectivity during the test -> Observe an error or auto-save attempt -> See guidance to resume or view partial submission status on reconnect

features.name: HR Dashboard (Jobs, Candidates, Analytics)
features.description: HR-facing tools to create and manage job postings, review candidate pools, invite candidates to tests, and view hiring analytics.
user_flows: Navigate to /hr/jobs -> Create a new job by providing title, JD, and experience range -> Submit job -> See job listed in /hr/jobs and visible in analytics
Navigate to /hr/jobs -> Attempt to create a job with missing required fields -> Submit form -> See validation errors and remain on job creation flow
Navigate to /hr/candidates -> View candidate list for a job -> Open a candidate profile -> Shortlist candidate or change candidate tier -> See candidate status update reflected in list
Navigate to /hr/candidates -> Shortlist a candidate -> Trigger assessment invite -> Observe that a time-limited magic link or invitation is queued/sent and candidate status updates accordingly
Navigate to /hr/analytics -> Select a job or date range -> View funnel metrics and candidate scoring breakdown -> Export analytics snapshot if needed
